the records: Surname *** 'Gonzalez Lerena' exact: 52 records ***, mostly Uruguay, some Mexico (Coahuila).

what: *** THE MATRIARCH, AND SHE IS NEW ***
the records: *** ESTEFANIA LERENA, married SERVANDO GONZALEZ. *** Twenty-eight records name her. Children traced so far: *** Servando Cecilio (1854-1911, Montevideo), Leopoldo, Francisco, Cesarea (chr. 30 April 1872, San Jose), Maria Bernarda, and Esperanza. ***
verdict: *** A Lerena woman with at least six children, wholly absent from this archive. *** *** She is NOT attached to Sancho's line by anything and is recorded unplaced. *** The name Estefania does not appear anywhere in this register.

what: *** IT REACHES COLONIA - WHICH IS ROW 156 ***
the records: *** Maria Bernarda Gonzalez Lerena, marriage registration 1931, CAMPANA, COLONIA. *** The family otherwise sits in San Jose and Montevideo.
verdict: *** Row 156 asks who the 189 Lerena records of Colonia are, and part of the answer is: they are not all called Lerena. *** *** A department counted by exact surname will under-count a compound family and then be reported as thin. *** Colonia was measured that way.

what: *** AND IT CLOSES THE FALSE POSITIVE PROPERLY ***
